notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level — DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as uk-west-midlands / uk-ellesmere-port / east-midlands / south-yorkshire / north-east / west-of-england / south-wales.

Single agency in scope (National Rail), single mode (train). Operators calling at these stations: Northern Trains, LNER, CrossCountry, TransPennine Express — all verdict 'in' per docs/west-yorkshire-d1/oracle-clash-report.md Board eligibility section (no compulsory reservations, no check-in barriers). No operator-level filtering is applied by this adapter because none is required — every operator that calls at an in-catalog station passes the walk-up boarding contract, so all Darwin trainServices entries at these CRS codes stay on the board unfiltered.

Buses (First West Yorkshire, Arriva Yorkshire, Transdev) and West Yorkshire Metro light rail are EXCLUDED — buses are static-GTFS-only with no confirmed real-time feed, deferred to a later wave; WY Metro is planning-stage only (Strategic Outline Case, March 2024), no passenger rail lines open. See docs/west-yorkshire-d1/published-network.json scopeNote.

doNotGroup: Bradford Forster Square (BDQ, secondary hub) vs. Bradford Interchange (BDI) — separate infrastructure, walk-link connect only. Both are catalog entries here since BDI also carries National Rail (Northern Trains) service, not just bus. See docs/west-yorkshire-d1/jim-handoff.md.

Denby Dale (DDL) is a through-running-only boundary station also carried in South Yorkshire's own catalog — cross-region de-dup NOT resolved here, flagged for D2 in both packs. Walsden (WAD) is a through-running-only boundary station toward Greater Manchester; no Greater Manchester pack exists yet to reconcile against.

stops.name: Leeds Station
stops.class: hub lock — major interchange, 18 platforms (0-17), Network Rail. Central hub for West Yorkshire Metro transit authority. doNotGroup vs. bus/coach platforms at the same station (forward note only — bus is out of v1 scope).

stops.name: Bradford Forster Square
stops.class: secondary hub — main Bradford rail station, Network Rail. Connected to Bradford Interchange (BDI) by walk-link only, not a shared platform — doNotGroup applies.

stops.name: Bradford Interchange
stops.class: through-running point, not a merge with Bradford Forster Square (BDQ) — separate infrastructure, serves both bus (city-centre coach station) and rail (Northern Trains services). doNotGroup vs. BDQ.

stops.name: Denby Dale
stops.class: through-running only, South Yorkshire boundary on the Penistone Line. Also carried in docs/south-yorkshire-d1/published-network.json (CRS left null there) — cross-region de-dup NOT resolved, flagged for D2.

stops.name: Walsden
stops.class: through-running only, Greater Manchester boundary on the Calder Valley Line. No Greater Manchester pack exists yet to reconcile against.

stops.name: Huddersfield
stops.class: regional station, Penistone Line hub — boundary to South Yorkshire via Denby Dale.

stops.name: Todmorden
stops.class: regional station, Calder Valley Line, West Yorkshire side before the Walsden boundary.

stops.name: Keighley
stops.class: regional station, Airedale Line from Leeds/Bradford, Northern Trains.
